scope: Read-only inspection of receipt segment flushing through the existing Home Assistant 2026.9.2 ChatLog and Assist pipeline; no runtime/configuration inspection.
conclusion: The existing supported ConversationEntity/ChatLog API has no receipt or segment flush signal. Closing an assistant message, beginning another assistant message, punctuation, or ending a ChatLog stream cannot start TTS for a short receipt before later content. There is no integration-only fix within the authorized constraints.

sources.finding: AssistantContentDeltaDict exposes role, content, thinking_content, tool_calls and native; no flush field.
A new role completes the prior chat message; stream exhaustion stores remaining content. Neither path emits a distinct TTS segment-completion signal. Native content is excluded from the listener.

The assistant delta listener starts TTS only after strictly more than STREAM_RESPONSE_CHARS (60) content characters or after nonempty content followed by actual tool_calls. A role/message boundary does not flush.
The TTS input end marker is sent only after async_converse returns, so closing one ChatLog message is not the same as completing the pipeline request.
The supported announcement entry point first awaits _cancel_running_pipeline(). It cannot be used as an in-flight receipt without cancelling the current Eva request.
Cancelling the running satellite pipeline cancels and awaits its current task.

existingIntegration.behavior: The receipt and answer chunks already enter the same actual ChatLog delta stream; supports_streaming is already enabled.

existingTests.limitation: These tests establish the integration's pre-final delta delivery and cancellation behavior, not Home Assistant TTS flush or physical audibility. They were not rerun for this unchanged-code inspection.

smallestRealChangeOutsideCurrentScope: An explicit, maintained segment-flush contract must be added upstream to ChatLog/Assist pipeline and consumed by the existing integration. No supported such contract was found in the pinned version. Do not silently patch or monkeypatch Home Assistant core.
rejectedWorkarounds: Calling announce during the current pipeline
Monkeypatching the pinned Home Assistant pipeline
acceptance: No immediate spoken receipt or owner acceptance claimed.

acknowledgementMediaCheck.finding: acknowledge_media_id appears in the config fields, but is not a short-utterance flush. ACKNOWLEDGE_PATH is used only as the final response after a local intent targeting the satellite area. It does not supply early acknowledgement during an ongoing Eva model response.
acknowledgementMediaCheck.changes: No HA source, firmware, pipeline or device changes.
